summary: Join our Building Resilience and Stress Management Training Course to learn essential skills for coping with stress and fostering personal growth and resilience
lede: Stress management and resilience training helps professionals leading teams or demanding work recognize stressors and respond constructively under pressure. Learners practice cognitive reframing, emotional self-regulation, and psychosocial risk identification, then apply these skills to energy-management plans and approaches to psychological safety on teams.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is built for professionals who manage high-stakes projects, lead diverse teams, or oversee organizational health and safety functions.
audience: Team Leads in high-pressure sectors like finance
modules: Foundations of Professional Resilience and Stress
Leading Resilient Teams and Psychological Safety
Digital Resilience and Information Load Management
Resilience in Times of Crisis and Change
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of experience in a management, project leadership, or HR role. Familiarity with basic organizational behavior concepts is recommended. No prior psychological training is required, but a willingness to engage in self-reflective exercises is essential.
